title: 🏛️ Exams 2018–2026 · the right word in context ⭐⭐

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2026, technical) A text says young people see that a college degree is not the only way to a good life. Which word completes the sentence?
"They're already waking up to the fact that there are plenty of ways to ___ a good living and live a happy life even without a college degree."
questions.explanation: To "earn a living" is to get money by working, which is the point of the sentence about jobs without a degree. "pay" means to give money, and "buy" means to get something in exchange for money, so neither says how someone gets an income.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2026, general) A text tells why a girl began planting trees. Which word completes the sentence?
"Her journey began at age seven, when a cyclone destroyed thousands of trees and ___ widespread devastation."
questions.explanation: "Cause" is followed directly by the result: the cyclone caused widespread devastation. "led" would need "to" ("led to devastation"), and "affected" takes the thing that is hit (affected the trees), so "affected devastation" does not work.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2025, general) A text says that sharing housework makes a child feel useful. Which word completes the sentence?
"When children ___ to family life, it helps them feel competent and responsible."
questions.explanation: The verb "contribute" is followed by "to": to give a part of the effort to a whole, here family life. "participate" is followed by "in", and "share" is followed by the thing shared, not by "to family life".

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2025, technical) A text presents Zainab, an apprentice in an all-female garage in Nigeria. Which word completes the sentence?
""I love the job I'm doing," she says as she opens the bonnet of a Peugeot to ___ its battery."
questions.explanation: She opens the bonnet of a car to check how the battery works: "test" is a verb that fits a mechanic's work. "apply" means to ask for a job or to put something on, which does not fit a battery, and "job" and "car" are nouns, but after "to" the sentence needs a verb.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2024, general) A man who is sixty tells why he became a volunteer. Which word completes the sentence?
"The main ___ was to be able to give back to his society."
questions.explanation: The sentence explains why he volunteers: it gives his "reason". A "solution" answers a problem, which the sentence does not mention, and a "donation" is a gift of money or goods, not an explanation.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2024, technical) A text tells how Monique Strong entered the building industry. Which word completes the sentence?
"Monique's teachers advised her to ___ Los Angles [sic] Technical College in order to learn and progress in her field."
questions.explanation: To "join" a college is to become one of its students. "enrol" is followed by "in" ("enrol in a college"), and "finish" would mean that she had already studied there. (The name of the city is printed with a spelling mistake in the exam.)

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2023, general) A text says parents should train children to do small tasks early. Which word completes the sentence?
"What is ___ is that parents should train their kids to do small tasks early."
questions.explanation: The sentence stresses the point that matters most: "important". "available" means that we can get or use something, and "interested" describes a person who feels interest; neither can describe a fact that "is that parents should train their kids".

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2022, general) A scientist says children who feel close to nature are happier. Which word completes the sentence?
"Our children are the future ___ of this planet."
questions.explanation: The scientist says that children who protect the planet and are happy are the future "protectors" of it. "loggers" cut down trees and "offenders" break rules, so both are against the idea of caring for nature in the same text.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2021, general) A text gives reasons for riding a bike to work, such as saving money and protecting the air. Which word completes the sentence?
"Importantly, cycling helps to ___ air pollution."
questions.explanation: Bikes burn no petrol, so cycling "reduces" pollution. "ruin" and "waste" are negative verbs: they would say that cycling spoils or loses the air pollution, which is not a benefit.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2020, general) A girl thanks her mother, who turned her hobby into a job to support the family. Which word completes the sentence?
"My mother has been a great ___ for me."
questions.explanation: A person who gives us the wish to be like her is an "inspiration". "relation" is the link between two people, not what a person gives to someone, and "dedication" is the quality of giving oneself to a goal; it would be used for her work, not "for me".

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2019, general) A text explains why volunteering is valuable. Which word completes the sentence?
"It gives you the satisfaction of playing a ___ in someone else's life and helping people who may not be able to help themselves."
questions.explanation: The fixed expression is "play a role in" someone's life, which means to have an effect on it. "play a game" would mean to take part in a sport, and "play a responsibility" does not exist: we say "take a responsibility".

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2018, general) A grown-up remembers her first day at school and longs for those days, but she cannot go back. Which word completes the sentence?
"And here ten years later, I ___ I could go back to those days and not have a care in the world."
questions.explanation: "I wish I could" expresses a regret about something that cannot be done. "want" is followed by "to" + verb, not by a clause, and "imagine" would only say what she pictures, not the regret of the speaker.
